settings.eyebrow: Live-edge · handcrafted · one of a kind
settings.heading: Wood with a story, built to hold yours.
settings.text: Live-edge shelves, boards and furniture cut from real slabs — each one keeping the natural edge of the tree it came from.

settings.title: Real slabs, real edges
settings.text: We keep the natural live edge of every board, so no two pieces look alike.

settings.title: Made by hand
settings.text: Cut, sanded and finished one at a time in our own shop — never mass-produced.

settings.title: Sized to your space
settings.text: Need a different length or depth? Every design can be built to order.

settings.heading: Sawdust, patience and a lot of coffee
settings.text: Tell your story here — how you got started, what you love to build, and what makes your work different. Customers buy handmade from people, so let them meet you.

settings.title: Pick the slab
settings.text: We choose each board for its grain, color and edge.

settings.title: Cut & flatten
settings.text: Milled flat and square while the live edge stays untouched.

settings.title: Hand finish
settings.text: Sanded smooth and sealed with durable, low-VOC finishes.

settings.title: Ship with care
settings.text: Wrapped by hand with hidden mounting hardware included.

settings.heading: Have something in mind? Let's build it.
settings.text: Shelves for an awkward wall, a table sized to your room, a board with your family name — tell us what you're picturing and we'll quote it.
